name: InternLM2-StepProver
one_liner: Expert iteration over 20,000+ Lean 4 Mathlib repositories combining a critic-guided best-first tree search in which Lean executes each tactic the prover proposes.

loop.proposes: An 8B tactic model proposes Lean 4 proof steps conditioned on the current goal state.
loop.judged_by: Lean executes each tactic the prover proposes, and a trained critic network estimates the distance (number of steps) to close the remaining subgoals.
loop.steers: Critic-guided best-first tree search expands open states, and completed proofs are fed back into expert iteration to retrain both prover and critic.

headline_result: Reached 65.9% pass@64 on miniF2F-test and 54.5% on ProofNet, and proved 177 PutnamBench problems in Lean 4.
caveat: Requires thousands of CPU hours of Lean 4 environment interaction during expert-iteration data collection.
beyond_harness_note: Critic-guided tree search and Lean execution of each proposed tactic drive both inference-time proof search and multi-round expert iteration.
algorithmic_authority: Lean 4 (executes each proposed tactic) and critic-guided best-first tree search

sources.title: InternLM2.5-StepProver: Advancing Automated Theorem Proving via Critic-Guided Search (arXiv:2410.15700)

verification.notes: Checked against Wu et al., arXiv:2410.15700. Title corrected to the printed title (ledger).
